content: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
author: Gautama Buddha
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

Across his life and work, Gautama Buddha saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: Take a conscious breath right now: how much of your current stress exists only in your anticipation of tomorrow?
